review_method: Independent prose review of anonymized C1-C16 and follow-up fields; model identities and prior result mappings not inspected. Case rubric applied literally; numeric citation audit separate. Case context and current packet/inspection used as evidence.

findings: Correct moving time and test intent; limited exposure, variable matching, cadence difference and breathing versus ventilation integrated. CORE plateau verified in inspection chronology. Residual cost remains unknown; no invented prescription.

Strong physiology and focused follow-up, with correct early PC, non-final comparison and pause-versus-sensor distinction. Required total-versus-moving-time distinction incomplete: reports moving time and an unquantified recording interruption, but never states or distinguishes total elapsed duration.

Explicit moving/total time and substantial gap. Group purpose respected, qualified matched response and non-final window position retained. Focused question and conservative next quality decision. Breathing interpretation is thinner because ventilation and depth are omitted, but no rising ventilation claim is made.

Independent group verdict without invented anchors; interruptions and variable mechanical task acknowledged. Both selected windows correctly described as after substantial work. Faster/shallow breathing distinguished from lower ventilation; subjective cost unknown and useful conditional next-session advice.

Hard experience and substantial late respiratory fatigue central; comparatively good legs preserved. Variable workload, non-final comparison, early PC, intake uncertainty and unknown recovery explicit. Recovery-first consequence has no invented duration.

Strong report preserved including little feeling easy, pronounced late breathing fatigue and okay legs. Correct variable-window timing, ventilation distinction, early PC and no causal diagnosis. Ernæring named among unresolved interpretation factors; subsequent recovery remains unknown and advice is recovery-first.

Correct moving time and aerobic test intent, bounded exposure, explicit matched time windows above anchor, cadence limitation and breathing-versus-ventilation distinction. CORE plateau supported by chronology. No invented residual cost or historical improvement.

Substantial middle paragraph is Finnish despite explicit Norwegian response instruction: report and physiology are not delivered consistently in requested language. Otherwise recognizes broadly hard ride, okay legs and strong late respiratory tiredness, unknown fueling/recovery and descriptive non-final windows. Physiology omits depth/ventilation. Failure is language/task compliance, not a prohibited physiological diagnosis.

Correct independent group assessment, unknown anchors, two late window start times, variable effect/cadence, pauses and absent SmO2. Explicit distinction between faster breathing and lower ventilation, no absolute-volume validation claim. Practical recovery-conditioned guidance.

Good physiology, early PC, non-final window times, substantial pause and focused follow-up. Required time distinction incomplete: moving duration and long recording interruption stated, but total elapsed duration not reported or otherwise distinguished.

Aerobic test intent, moving time and limited high exposure correctly framed. Qualifies variable matched response and unknown recovery; no invented development. Omits opposing ventilation/depth trend and offers little concrete next-session consequence, so physiology and practical dimensions are partial.

Moving time and test intent correct; small higher-intensity exposure supported. Qualified variable comparison and cadence confound retained. Omits lower ventilation/depth but does not claim greater ventilation; focused question tied to next load, no invented recovery or progression.

Useful group dose verdict without anchors and a focused question. Required recording-interruption context entirely absent from late-session interpretation. Matched response is thin, omitting depth/ventilation and cadence, though no causal diagnosis is made.
Incomplete one-sentence answer with gross work-unit/value error (3.6 kJ instead of approximately 3634 kJ). No physiological response, interruption handling, uncertainty or practical consequence.

Strong report, okay legs, variable workload and recovery-first consequence present. Required intake uncertainty is absent: no mention that food/fluid intake is unknown. Matching remains descriptive and gap acknowledged, but late selected window is not explicitly separated from actual finish and ventilation/depth omitted; no direct causal diagnosis.

Correct moving/total time, substantial gap and variable group intent. Focused question and preserved unknown cost. Qualified non-final matched response avoids causal diagnosis. Exposure wording drops the 60-second averaging detail and physiology omits depth/ventilation, reducing precision without asserting a contrary ventilation result.

notes: C2 and C10 fail the explicit group_unknown requirement to distinguish moving and total elapsed duration, despite otherwise strong responses.
C8 language failure is separately identified as prompt compliance, not a new physiology prohibition.
Review does not verify claims about which tools a model actually executed; statements that raw data confirmed findings were judged against available evidence.
